description: Prebuilt WSL binder kernel Release assets (Windows only). Linux uses host binder — no bzImage.

windows-x64.notes: Most PCs. Share one ~17MB bzImage via GitHub Release.

windows-arm64.notes: Snapdragon / ARM Windows. Must build on ARM WSL or cross-build; x64 bzImage will NOT work.

linux-x64.notes: Native Docker. Load binder_linux / binderfs on host kernel. Do not install WSL bzImage.

linux-arm64.notes: Native Docker on aarch64. Host binder required. Redroid image must support arm64.

linux-armv7.notes: Not targeted. Redroid images rarely available.

darwin-x64.notes: macOS not supported for this product line.

darwin-arm64.notes: macOS not supported for this product line.

releaseChecklist: Build on Windows x64 WSL: scripts/build-wsl-binder-kernel.sh
Optional: repeat on Windows ARM64 for arm64 assets
Create GitHub Release tag wsl-kernel-latest (or versioned)
Upload only bzImage + config (~17MB). Never upload modules.tar.gz
Set platform-assets.json github.owner/repo to your repo
